visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera focuses on a silver-colored bathtub faucet mounted on a wall of light-beige square tiles. A hand with dark manicured nails enters the frame, pointing directly at the faucet's controls and the lower spout. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the metallic texture of the fixtures and the slightly textured surface of the tiles. The tub itself is a cream color and contains water with a pinkish tint. (2) The camera pans upwards to follow the silver shower hose leading to the showerhead mounted high on the wall. The hand continues to point, tracking the line from the faucet up to the showerhead. (3) The camera pans down rapidly to reveal a young woman sitting in the bathtub, covered in a thick layer of white soap bubbles up to her chest. She wears a plush white headband adorned with small red hearts and a large red bow in the style of Hello Kitty. Her dark hair is pulled back, and her face and shoulders are visibly glistening with water. She looks directly into the camera lens while speaking, her expression a mix of resignation and amusement. The background remains the tiled bathroom wall.
